planets.name: TOI-700 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-700 with a 27.8-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-700 e was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-700. Its orbit and size follow Pass et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname PASS_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2023, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 27.810124, pl_radj 0.08198783, pl_bmassj 0.00226

quotes.title: TOI-700 e
quotes.card: TOI-700 e is the second outermost known exoplanet orbiting TOI-700, a red dwarf star in the constellation of Dorado.
